subject.title: fix(hooks): use truncateUtf16Safe for LLM slug generator session content

question: Should maintainers require real slug-generator prompt-path proof for this external PR, or explicitly override the proof gate for this narrow internal Unicode-boundary fix?
rationale: The source bug and helper-based fix are clear, but the contributor has not supplied real behavior proof, and a sibling PR with better regression coverage remains proof-blocked too.

options.title: Require proof and coverage
options.body: Ask this contributor to add redacted real prompt-path proof and preferably the same focused regression coverage before this PR can be considered land-ready.

options.title: Override the proof gate
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept source, CI, and helper-contract evidence as enough for this narrow internal prompt-boundary change.

options.title: Consolidate on the sibling branch
options.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102672 if it receives proof or a maintainer override, because it already carries the same runtime fix plus a regression test.

recommendation.title: Require proof and coverage
recommendation.body: Ask this contributor to add redacted real prompt-path proof and preferably the same focused regression coverage before this PR can be considered land-ready.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent is the listed Hooks owner and has recent adjacent UTF-16-safe truncation work, making him the clearest proof-sufficiency/consolidation decision owner from the available history.
